vendor.blurb: Open trillion-param MoE; MiMo-V2.6-Pro tops AA's open-weights board, RL data included

mimo-v2.6-pro.tagline: Strongest open-weights model, still dirt cheap
highlights: AA Intelligence Index 46, #1 open weights, level with Grok 4.7
#1 on Vals Index open weights; MIT license, native image/audio/video input
mimo-v2.6-pro.notes: Architecture follows V2.5, adding 1M context and an MTP drafter; the RL training run was livestreamed. Early users report uneven performance at launch.
mimo-v2.6-pro.pricing: $0.435 / $0.87 per 1M tokens (99% discount on cache hits)

mimo-v2.6-flash.tagline: A coding Flash cheap enough to spam
highlights: AA Intelligence Index 38, near DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (39)
#2 on Vals Index open weights, behind its own Pro
On opencode's $10 plan, ~30,000 requests per 5 hours
mimo-v2.6-flash.notes: Variants such as Flash-RL and Flash-MOPD also have weights out. Community says it beats DeepSeek on a good day, but stability is poor.
